behavior: Record CPU vendor/model where available, Torch build/capability/thread counts and an explicit allowlist of numerical-library variables before real weight loading.
Both failed and successful export attempts retain context; successful manifests audit its bytes/SHA.
Remove stale prior context at the start of a new attempt so early preprocessing failure cannot inherit the previous host.
No arbitrary environment dump, hostname or secrets recorded.
Original official inference, expected features, coefficients, dtype, tolerances, standard ReferenceEvaluator and export algorithms remain unchanged.
